description:
Free manifest validator for SAP MCP premium plugins. Validates ids, semver, descriptions, strict input/output schemas, x402/pay.sh pricing policies, and delivery contracts. It never executes plugin code or loads provider secrets.

SAP MCP execution guidance: Intent: SAP MCP tool workflow. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required.

inputSchema.description: Validate Premium Plugin Manifest input schema. Intent: SAP MCP tool workflow. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required. Use exact field names from this schema; do not guess aliases or include private key material.

manifest.description: Premium plugin manifest candidate to validate before publishing or loading from a private plugin directory.

errors.description: Blocking manifest issues. Do not load or publish the plugin until empty.

valid.description: True only when the manifest can be safely reviewed for premium plugin loading.
